title: Home event schedule v1
description: Partial, fresh account-observed availability, never a full catalog. Home admits challenge, bonus, limited and z-battles; growth only with active Burst; excludes Story/DB Story/quests/unknown. Burst first, then its own start or eventStartsAt descending, real end ascending, stable id; deduplicate typed targets before max 20. Preview reserves at most one Burst before recent ordinary events when available. Active Burst uses its own independent observed availability bound; base eventStartsAt/eventEndsAt are omitted/null in that case. Old consumers ignore optional additions. Rotation boundaries never imply novelty or urgency.

eventStartsAt.description: Optional overall API start_at, at or before availableFrom; not first-ever release, not weekday start, not observation time. Missing/null means unknown; invalid optional values degrade to unknown in Android.

burstMode.description: Optional fresh resources/login genkai_battles schedule exactly joined by area_id. Independent from base event dates and weekday rotation. Never inferred from is_new, titles, or modifiers. Highlight only while startsAt <= now < validUntil; validUntil <= endsAt and source expire_at. A base-area destination is not a Burst configuration screen.

headerImageUrl.description: Legacy optional poster from event_image. Not suitable for horizontal previews; superseded by the shared eventArtwork registry using listbutton_image.
